## `cidx git`

Usage: `cidx git [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...`

```text
Git history search and branch operations (remote mode only).

Provides access to git history, commits, branches, and blame information
for repositories indexed on the CIDX server.
```

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [`blame`](#cidx-git-blame) | Show what revision and author last modified each line of a file. |
| [`branch-create`](#cidx-git-branch-create) | Create a new branch. |
| [`branch-delete`](#cidx-git-branch-delete) | Delete a branch. |
| [`branch-switch`](#cidx-git-branch-switch) | Switch to a branch. |
| [`branches`](#cidx-git-branches) | List all branches. |
| [`cat`](#cidx-git-cat) | Show file content at a specific revision. |
| [`checkout-file`](#cidx-git-checkout-file) | Checkout a file from HEAD, discarding local changes. |
| [`clean`](#cidx-git-clean) | Remove untracked files from working tree. |
| [`commit`](#cidx-git-commit) | Create a commit with staged changes. |
| [`diff`](#cidx-git-diff) | Show changes between commits, commit and working tree, etc. |
| [`fetch`](#cidx-git-fetch) | Fetch changes from remote without merging. |
| [`file-history`](#cidx-git-file-history) | Show commit history for a specific file. |
| [`log`](#cidx-git-log) | Show commit history. |
| [`merge-abort`](#cidx-git-merge-abort) | Abort a merge in progress. |
| [`pull`](#cidx-git-pull) | Pull changes from remote repository. |
| [`push`](#cidx-git-push) | Push commits to remote repository. |
| [`reset`](#cidx-git-reset) | Reset working tree to a commit. |
| [`search-commits`](#cidx-git-search-commits) | Search commits by message content. |
| [`search-diffs`](#cidx-git-search-diffs) | Search for a pattern in diff content. |
| [`show`](#cidx-git-show) | Show details of a specific commit. |
| [`stage`](#cidx-git-stage) | Stage files for commit. |
| [`status`](#cidx-git-status) | Show working tree status. |
| [`unstage`](#cidx-git-unstage) | Unstage files from the index. |

## `cidx git reset`

Usage: `cidx git reset [OPTIONS]`

```text
Reset working tree to a commit.

WARNING: --mode hard is destructive and requires --confirm flag.
```

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|--------|------|---------|----------|-------------|
| `--repository`, `-r` | text |  | yes | Repository alias |
| `--mode` | choice: `soft`, `mixed`, `hard` | `mixed` | no | Reset mode (soft/mixed/hard) |
| `--commit` | text |  | no | Target commit (default: HEAD) |
| `--confirm` | flag |  | no | Confirm destructive operation (required for --mode hard) |
| `--json` | flag |  | no | Output as JSON |
